headline: President Clinton amended an earlier order that sets up the Intelligence Oversight Board, a White House panel that reviews US intelligence activities.
what_it_does: This order changes Executive Order 12863, which set up the Intelligence Oversight Board. The board advises the President on whether US intelligence activities follow the law. The title does not say exactly what was changed, so the details of the amendment are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the Intelligence Oversight Board
who_it_affects.how: The order changes the rules in the earlier order that sets up and guides their board.
